annotations.text:
CONTROL ROOM (leading direction)
Viewport first, presets always visible on the right, one transport strip. Amber = selected/active, teal = connected/OK, red = tally/record. Best for a single operator driving one camera live.
Tradeoff: presets are a list, so fewer visible at once than the Deck.

SUPPORTING SCREENS (same system as Control Room)
Add camera: name + IP, VISCA port defaults to 52381, video source auto-fills rtsp://IP:8554/live, test result shows firmware and position.
Mapping: every control is an action with MIDI / OSC / keyboard columns and a Learn button; one row shown mid-learn.

DIRECTION B: DECK
Preset wall with big touch tiles, physical-controller style keys, light warm surface. Best for tablet / touch operation and preset-heavy shows.
Tradeoff: smaller viewport, less room for fine controls.

DIRECTION C: RACK
Multi-camera first: a rack of cameras with tally state, the selected camera large, presets as a dense table with MIDI and keyboard columns. Best for 2-4 Tail 2s driven by one person.
Tradeoff: denser and keyboard-centric, less touch friendly.
